permissionHint: To find the qibla direction accurately, allow the app to access your location.
errorHint: Make sure location services are on, then try again.
hint: Hold your phone flat and turn until the arrow points at the Kaaba
calibrate: Move your phone in a figure 8 to calibrate the compass
interference: Magnetic interference may make the direction inaccurate. Move away from electronics, metal and magnets (like a case or charger), then move your phone in a figure 8
